title: RT as Projection of Core Expression

basis.scope: Record the hypothesis that completed RT expressions may be domain-specific projections of a Core Expression. The basis is documentary and governed, not theorem-level; it inherits explicit rebinding from 046 and asymmetry support from 047 while keeping RT_core distinct from the proposed Core Expression hypothesis.

core_rule.statement: Completed RT expressions may be modeled as projections of a Core Expression only when the projection is typed by domain, scale, and admissibility; the projection remains provisional, non-unique, and not invertible by default, and RT_core remains unchanged.

core_hypothesis.statement: Every completed RT may be representable as a projection of the Core Expression under a domain, scale, and admissibility structure.
core_hypothesis.stronger_forbidden_form: Every RT is identical to the Core Expression.

relationship_to_prior_patches.PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_046: Provides governed slot occupancy through explicit rebinding.
relationship_to_prior_patches.PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_047: Establishes that A|E distinction conserves asymmetry, not slot symmetry.
relationship_to_prior_patches.048_extension: Asks whether all such completed RTs are projections from a common generative core.

non_claims: Does not claim all RTs are identical.
Does not identify the Core Expression with RT_core.
open_questions: Can different projections yield the same RT?
Does residue arise from non-invertible projection?
Is A|E a projection operation or a projected structure?
What quantities are invariant under projection?

required_followup.task: Define admissible projection typing for π_x(Core Expression) -> RT_x.
Determine whether projection preserves closure, identity, residue, orientation, and basin signature.
Produce one worked projection example using an already governed RT expression.
Keep projection-from-core separate from RT_core modification until all checks pass.

agent_instruction: Record this as a proposed provisional induction only. Use additive mode, tie provenance to applied patches 046 and 047, preserve RT_core unchanged, and do not update textbook surfaces.

required_repo_changes.description: Add a single governed example projecting the Core Expression into an existing RT witness.
Add the ordered projection trace covering domain typing, admissibility, projection, RT closure, and comparison.
Add the invariant audit showing which quantities are preserved and transformed under projection.
